name: rpg-kit
description: Reusable RPG foundations for Volt 3D games: procedural iron sword, katana, greatsword and dagger models; damageable humanoid-style enemy NPCs with chase and melee attack AI; and shared combat-kit integration.

snippets.label: RPG kit (sword and enemy NPCs)
snippets.description: Import after game.volt and combat.volt. Call rpgEquipSword() once, rpgStepEnemies() and rpgSwordStep() every frame, and rpgSwordAttack() when the attack key is pressed.
